fields.description: Altus is a two-tower apartment development near Creek Beach in Dubai Creek Harbour. One to three bedroom homes combine balconies with open living areas, while shared pools, fitness spaces and a yoga area form the leisure offering. The towers have distinct floor plans, including larger podium balconies and more compact upper-floor layouts.

research.community: Dubai Creek Harbour · near Creek Beach
overview: The brochure pairs city-facing apartments with access to the creek-side neighbourhood and nearby park. It describes contemporary bathrooms, built-in storage and balconies as part of the home layouts. Its environmental brief includes shade from balconies and ledges, tinted glazing, LED lighting with common-area controls, and condensate or planter drainage collected for landscape irrigation. These are design intentions; final specifications should be checked in the sales documents.
research.locationNote: The developer places Altus close to the creek promenade, neighbourhood green space and Creek Beach. Central Park, Creek Marina and the Viewing Point are wider district destinations. Published metro walking times and references to future connections should be checked against operational stations and actual routes.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s available-unit section starts at AED 3,991,888, while its headline still says AED 1.6m. The July 2024 fact sheet lists launch starts of AED 1.6m for one bedroom, AED 2.55m for two and AED 3.8m for three. The displayed unit price does not imply all categories remain available.
research.paymentNote: The launch document totals 10% booking, 70% during construction and 20% on completion. Property Finder instead reports 20% booking, 70% construction and 10% handover. The table below reproduces the launch document; request written current terms before relying on either summary.
research.handoverNote: January 2029 is the estimated completion month in the launch payment document and Property Finder. Construction milestones and the contractual date require current confirmation.

facts.label: Published collection
facts.value: The launch fact sheet reports 280 apartments. This is a project mix figure, not the number currently for sale.

facts.label: Tower 1 balcony comparison
facts.value: Three-bedroom podium unit P103 totals 1,927.06 sq ft, including a 433.14 sq ft balcony. Podium unit P203 has a similar suite area but a 121.09 sq ft balcony, bringing its total to 1,613.08 sq ft.

facts.label: Tower 2 layout differences
facts.value: First-floor two-bedroom unit 104 totals 1,453.88 sq ft, including 401.92 sq ft of balcony. The corresponding upper-floor layout totals 1,155.29 sq ft. Outdoor space explains much of the size difference.

facts.label: Availability sources differ
facts.value: Emaar’s page lists selected units, while Property Finder labels the developer project out of stock and shows resale listings. Confirm sale type and availability directly for the unit being considered.
